spans.s: (I)--a महारथ; was stationed on the southern gate of मथुरा, and on the western gate of Gomanta by जरासन्ध when he besieged them. भा. X. ५०. ११ [3]; ५२. ११ [१२].
--(Aridyota-ब्र्। प्।)--the son of Dundubhi and father of Punarvasu. भा. IX. २४. २०.
--a looking-glass to be installed by the side of a deity. M. ५७. १८; २६५. १९; २८९. १०.
(I)--a son of अजातशत्रु and father of Ajaya. भा. XII, 1. 6.
--a R. of the केतुमाल country. वा. ४४. १७. [page२-076+ २६]

--a hill tribe;
1: Br. II. १६. ६७.
a mountain kingdom.
2: M. ११४. ५६; वा. ४५. १३६.
--one of the wives of उशिनर and mother of Suvrata. Br. III. ७४. १८ and २०. वा. ९९. १९.
(I)--the son of धाता and सिनीवालि. भा. VI. १८. 3.
(II)--a son of कृष्ण and कालिन्दि. भा. X. ६१. १४.
(III)--a son of ब्रह्मा and मन्त्रसरीर: a Jayadeva. Br.
--one of the five queens of उशीनर; father of Suvrata. M. ४८. १६, १८. [page२-077+ २३]
--a king of Magadha; ruled for २५ years. वा. ९९. ३१८.
--a यक्ष; son of पुण्यजनी and मणि- bhadra. Br.
--a name for the २७थ् Kalpa; here Soma became पौर्णमासि. वा. २१. ६७, ६९.

(I)--the charioteer of कृष्ण;
1: भा. X. ५०. १६. २० [5]. [8]; ६४. [6]; ७१. १२. Vi. V. ३७. ५१.
went with कृष्ण to शाल्व's station, and drove the chariot when कृष्ण gained लक्ष्मणा by svayamvara;
2: भा. X. ७७. 9-११; ८३. ३३.
took कृष्ण to मिथिला and the Videha country.
3: Ib. ८६. १७; ५३. 4.
His son was the charioteer of

: Ib. ७६. २७.
Stood before कृष्ण on the eve of His return- ing from the earth. कृष्ण asked him to inform the द्वारका people of the position of the यादवस् at प्रभास and advise them to go to Indraprastha with Arjuna. Returning to the city, दारुक informed Vasudeva and others accordingly.
5: Ib. XI. ३०. ४१-50; ३१. १५-17; Vi. V. ३७. ५७-64.
[page२-084+ २८]
(II)--the अवतार् of the Lord in the २१स्त् Dva1- para with sons in the holy दारुवन. वा. २३. ९५.

--on the हिमालयन् crests; the abode of sages in कृतयुग engaged in severe austerities; शिव appeared before them naked and sometimes wept and some- times danced; the womenfolk were enchanted by him; the angry sages cursed him to become an ass and at- tempted to cut off his लिन्गम्; the Lord disappear- ed; finding the world beset with difficulties and dangers the sages appealed to ब्रह्मा and learnt that it was due to शिव; hence they made images of लिन्ग and offered worship for a year; the Lord appeared before them, and was praised by all;
1: Br. II. २
